name: The Gem Theatre
online_fee: $1 per ticket for online advance tickets
good_to_know: Kids under 2 sitting on an adult's lap don't need a ticket.
Children 15 and under must be with an adult (18+) at all times.
R-rated films: guests 16 and under need a guardian 21+ for the whole show. Bring ID.
Online ticket? Bring the card you paid with, or the confirmation on your phone or printed.
Movies and times can change: check the ticket page or call 704-932-5111.
accessibility: Wheelchair access and infrared assistive listening devices are available. Ask at least 24 hours ahead: 704-932-5126 or gem@kannapolisnc.gov.
parking: Free public parking downtown (Laureate Way, West Avenue, City Hall and nearby lots); drop-off and pick-up at the Gem on Laureate Way. A free West Avenue Express shuttle runs 5–10 p.m. Friday–Sunday, April–December.

support.text: Sponsor a marquee sidewalk brick or a seat in the auditorium.
